title: Marks header for open schedule
goal: Write a title for the table, indicating the meaning of each column and the venue corresponding to each row.
summary: caption is the title of the entire table, thead holds the row where the column title is located. th marks the header cell, scope="col" means it corresponds to a column, scope="row" means it corresponds to a row.
tasks: Add caption at the front of the table and fill in "Venue opening hours".
Move the first row containing "venue" and "opening hours" into thead, change these two cells to th, and set scope="col" respectively.
Keep both venue records in tbody. Change the cells containing "table tennis room" and "Painting and Calligraphy Studio" to th elements, set scope="row" on each, and keep the times in td elements.

example.code:
Today’s snack
Dessertsprice
sesame cake8 yuan
example.note: "price" marks the meaning of the entire column, and "sesame cake" marks the row corresponding to 8 yuan.

hint: The thickening of the cells only indicates a change in appearance. Check the actual tags and scope used. The venue name written at the beginning of the record needs to mark the corresponding line.
